data.title: About Erica
bio: Erica Bilezikjian has lived in Old Bridge, NJ for 20 years.  Originally from Staten Island, she moved to New Jersey with her husband to start their family and is now a proud mom of four.  Before real estate, Erica spent 17 years as a NYC school teacher before choosing to stay home with her children and explore her passion for sales.

In 2014, she opened her own women’s boutique, building strong relationships and a loyal clientele through her personalized service.  Her long-standing love for real estate led her to become a licensed agent in 2024.  Erica is committed to listening, understanding her clients’ needs, and guiding them through one of life’s biggest decisions with care and attention to detail.
If you’re looking for an agent who truly puts you first, call 917-885-7297.
